text: Introduction: Aim to cultivate students to master the basic knowledge of solid linguistics, literature and culture; Master five Japanese abilities: listening, speaking, reading, writing and translating; Hold the high sprits of cooperating and creative; Adjust to translate, manage, teach and research in the departments like diplomacy, international trade, culture and education; Main Courses Fundamental Period: Japanese Intensive Reading, Japanese Extensive Reading, Listening Japanese, Spoken Japanese, Writing Japanese, Listening, Spoken and Video in Japanese, Introduction to Japan, and etc. Professional Period: Senior Japanese Writing, History of Japanese Literature, Written Japanese Translation, Oral Japanese Interpretation, Selected Reading of Japan Literature, Simultaneous Interpretation, and etc.
